m1.vds.why: Degenerate fuzz circuit: n2 touches only R2, so the vdd/n2 island has no current return path. M1's drain current is exactly 0, which forces Vds = 0 (both simulators report noise around 0), Rin is truly infinite (ngspice's 7.4e18 Ω is LU noise), and Rout depends on gbd at that noise-level Vds.
